__comment: Codex review #24 finding 1: repository code cannot constrain local AWS credentials — the boundary must be IAM itself. OWNER-APPLIED (attach to the local IAM identity; do not let the local identity retain iam:* on itself). Effect: local credentials may still launch calibration-tier jobs (tagged medzen-tier=calibration by the launcher) but can NEVER create an arm-tier training job — those require the medzen-arm-launch-role, reachable only through the owner-approved GitHub environment.
